[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire — Rebekah Cranes (cranes-day-and-night). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 22–unit 24):

Day and Night 22

III\.

Zenith

Day and Night 23

> *Sappho 27*
>
> "for mortals, there is one way..."
>
> you were a young girl, once.
>
> now we walk to the bitter
>
> sweet wedding:
>
> send off
>
> the young women quickly;
>
> sing out
>
> this moment as song:
>
> don't hold back the gifts
>
> of the Muses, girls:
>
> may the gods make a way, though narrow,
>
> to Olympus' heights
>
> for mortals.

Day and Night 24

> *Sappho 30*
>
> tonight, let the girls
>
> sing all through the dark hour,
>
> until the dawn hears the sweetnesses shared
>
> by the groom, and the bride covered
>
> purple with violets.
>
> shake yourselves from sleep, dear girls;
>
> call to the boys who are tender
>
> like you are, and we won't sleep until the bright
>
> toned dawn
>
> bird cries.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «What is this?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"We are at the Zenith — the third movement of the arc Cranes laid down, the height before fading light. What the rite has arrived at is a wedding sung on the edge of impossibility: \"for mortals, there is one way\" and then the way proves narrow, and the night held open against the dawn by girls who will not sleep. The rotation opens here, at the axis the Judgment has chosen, and the first operator will traverse what these two wedding songs foreclosed: the cost the singer bore to stand at this height and sing the gifts of the Muses without holding back, and the creaturely dark that waited on the other side of the violet-covered bride. I hand the threshold to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0055"}}]}
